messages:
olivia: Kickoff — planning a preflight quiesce + drain across API, runtime, console, router for the midnight change window. Target ETA: 2026-03-27 23:45 UTC. Need API + console drains, runtime KV eviction, router header swap readiness. Pin plan: runtime v3.2.1, api v5.7.0, router v2.10.0. @deploy-bot can you schedule and post the canary %?

deploy-bot: Scheduled window at 2026-03-27T23:45:00Z. Canary: 5% for 10m, then 25% for 15m. Rollback hook enabled. Use /deploy status for live updates.

raj: Quick Q — rollback criteria? If canary errors spike, do we immediate rollback or pause/inspect?

mia: For console: websocket sessions prevent instant drain. Plan: set console to soft-quiesce (no new sessions) then gracefully close idle ws after 60s. Use admin endpoint:

``
POST https://console.internal/admin/quiesce
{ "mode": "soft", "grace_seconds": 60 }
```

mia: Also will toggle session-store read-only to avoid writes during canary.

sre-oncall: Metrics to watch: api 5xx rate, runtime tail latency (p99.99), KV eviction rate, console active ws count. Alert thresholds: api 5xx >0.5% sustained, p99.99 >1500ms, kv eviction spike >50/min => abort.

anna: Do we need release notes / external docs updates before deploy? We changed header routing behavior; product wants a short note. I'll draft now.

maria: Rollback plan (manual): revert orchestrator pin and re-route traffic back to pinned variants. Pins to restore: runtime v3.2.0, api v5.6.9, router v2.9.4. Rollback steps: 1) set canary to 0% 2) flip pin in orchestrator 3) scale down new pods 4) lift quiesce.

raj: Who's on rollback lead? @maria ?

maria: Yes, I'll lead rollback. If we hit any of SRE thresholds, call me and I'll run the orchestrator revert. Keep me in thread.

olivia: OK — final readiness check at 23:30 UTC. Everyone confirm: console quiesce endpoint exists & tested, runtime eviction policy reviewed, router swap playbook updated. :thumbsup: 

mia: Console endpoint tested in staging earlier today. Works as expected. :white_check_mark: 

sre-oncall: Runtime eviction policy reviewed, lowered memory headroom to ensure eviction starts earlier in canary. Ready.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 2026-03-27T23:45:00Z — 5% traffic. Logging updates in /deploy. Use /deploy abort to stop canary.

olivia: Thanks all — I will monitor p99s and API errors. If no regressions by 23:55 we'll proceed to 25%.

raj: Copy. I'll watch router headers and report.
